appLock.title: Ritme is locked
appLock.subtitle: Enter your Ritme passcode
appLock.wrong: That passcode isn't right. Try again.
appLock.blocked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
appLock.forgotBody: To open Ritme without the passcode you need to sign out and sign in again with the SMS code. Your data stays on the server and the lock is removed.
appLock.forgotConfirm: Sign out and sign in again
appLock.mismatch: The two passcodes didn't match. Start again.
appLock.localNote: The passcode is kept only on this phone, encrypted, and is never sent to the server.
appLock.lockedOut: Too many wrong passcodes. To protect your data you are being signed out; sign in again with the SMS code.
